test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct option to rearrange the following sentences to form a coherent paragraph:

A. The old watch ticked steadily on the shelf.

B. It had survived generations of owners.

C. Each scratch and dent told a different story.

D. Time seemed frozen around it.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph is about a watch that has been passed down through generations, and the sentences must be arranged to form a coherent flow of ideas.
 
• **Sentence A is the first sentence** as it introduces the subject of the paragraph—the old watch:
 
 
• "The old watch ticked steadily on the shelf."
 
 
• **Sentence B follows** as it adds context to the watch's history and its significance:
 
 
• "It had survived generations of owners."
 
 
• **Sentence C is the third sentence** because it describes the physical appearance of the watch and its symbolic meaning:
 
 
• "Each scratch and dent told a different story."
 
 
• **Sentence D is the fourth** as it concludes the paragraph by creating a poetic and timeless impression:
 
 
• "Time seemed frozen around it."
 
 
• The correct sequence is **ABCD**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The old watch ticked steadily on the shelf. It had survived generations of owners. Each scratch and dent told a different story. Time seemed frozen around it."
